profile.name: 多道分析器（MCA）
profile.description: 多道分析器是一种用于辐射探测信号能谱测量的电子仪器，可将探测器输出的脉冲按幅度分箱并形成能谱。它常用于 X 射线或伽马射线谱测量、峰分析、感兴趣区域计数以及同步辐射和核探测实验中的能量分辨检测。
profile.description_en: A multichannel analyzer is an electronic instrument used for energy-spectrum measurements of radiation detector signals. It sorts detector pulses by amplitude into channels to build a spectrum, and is commonly used for X-ray or gamma-ray spectroscopy, peak analysis, region-of-interest counting, and energy-resolved detection in synchrotron and nuclear experiments.

registry.name: EPICS MCA Record Module X射线衍射仪
registry.description: EPICS MCA Record Module X射线衍射仪是由Argonne National Lab (EPICS)生产的X射线衍射仪，主要功能包括停止。支持Signal, Slot, add rois等操作。
